title: sprint-006 completed — Service categories validated
summary: Top 5 service categories for Malta MVP defined and ranked. TAM ~€8.5M/yr. No AI-platform competition identified.
details: Categories (priority order): 1. Home Cleaning (€60-120, weekly repeat) 2. Repairs/Handyman (€50-200, high Malta housing demand) 3. Beauty/Wellness mobile (€30-80, female 25-45 demographic) 4. Tutoring (€20-40/hr, expat families + Univ. Malta) 5. Pet Care (€15-35, +34% dog ownership since 2021). Malta market: 95% services transacted via FB groups — no structured platform exists. Bark.com Malta stale (<50 providers). Task.com.mt static listings. Platform has clear first-mover advantage.
